source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Yoledet, Chapter 2 2 + Onkelos Lev 12:5
claim_en: THE VOCALIZATION SEAT. Two-weeks vs seventy argued at the word itself; 'the reading has a mother'; Onkelos's fourteen the oldest witness.

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Yoledet, Chapter 2 4 + Section 1 5
claim_en: MIDDAH CASE LAW. Dayo held against every rephrasing; the stringent-to-lenient inference voided on form.
THE COUNT'S ANCHOR. Seven from the last child; consecutive; birth days as menstrual days; birth-not-conception decides; caesarean excluded with the dissent.
MILAH OVERRIDES SHABBAT at its source; day-only; the diligent early; certain-not-doubtful; the reframed born-circumcised dispute.
THE FIVE BLOODS AND THE MARKET. The source rule; the five-shade table with both houses; one offering per term; the gold-dinar price collapse.

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Yoledet, Chapter 3 5 + Chapter 4 1-3
claim_en: THE ORDER SWAP. Olah written first with the kind-matching rule; atonement by the chatat; one withholder; the dignity floor of the poverty scale.

source: Mishnah Niddah 3:3, 3:6, 6:14, 10:6-7; Sifra, Tazria Parashat Yoledet, Chapter 1 7-8, Chapter 2 2-3; Sifra, Metzora Parashat Zavim, Section 5 4
claim_en: THE CLOCKS SUMMED. Lev 12's four written numbers add to Mishnah Niddah 6:14's forty and eighty (7 + 33, 14 + 66) — the totals the sheet names are the ink's arithmetic; the union of the clocks for the unknown miscarriage computed from the same numbers; 12:4's two gates carry Niddah 10:6-7.
